Prisma adaptation, 2026-10-09: JavaScript module, independent of Orb presets;
configurable threshold, attack/release and frequency bands; device selection;
noise calibration RMS; hysteresis; release after stop; resource cleanup on
failure/cancellation; audio player reattachment after inspector rendering.
The input, FFT/RMS analysis, band averaging and exponential smoothing are
derived from OrbAudioInput. Prisma parameter mappings and UI are separate.

Second adaptation, 2026-10-09: interactive audio context; 1024-sample FFT
without duplicate smoothing; band power replaces mean log-magnitude bins;
adaptive reference levels, gain before envelope and response curve;
peak signal and spectral-flux input from the separately credited MIT module
in ../sound-to-light/. Microphone requests unprocessed audio where supported.
